Different experiences can reveal shared needs. Interviewing travelers with varying levels of points experience taught me to look beyond individual preferences and use common patterns to guide product priorities.
 AI helped me build faster, but I still had to decide what was worth building. At the hackathon, I turned our interview findings into a PRD and used AI coding tools to build a working prototype. Testing it with users helped me see where those decisions worked and where they needed refinement.
 The process reinforced two lessons: making information available is only useful if people can easily understand and act on it, and an established visual palette helps multiple designers create one cohesive experience.
